summary.text: Jason Bean, a Republican, represents Missouri Senate District 25 in the Bootheel and southeast Missouri; he was first elected in 2020 and re-elected in 2024.
He chairs the Senate Agriculture, Food Production and Outdoor Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bean is a fifth-generation Missourian raised in the Bootheel and lives on the farm where he grew up.
He attended the University of Missouri-Columbia, majoring in agronomy and minoring in animal science, and then worked to turn the family farm into an agribusiness.
From 2002 to 2011 he served on the United Soybean Board.
He has served as interim superintendent of the University of Missouri's top agricultural research facility and was elected chair of the advisory board of MU's Fisher Delta Research Center.
He received the 2015 Missouri Governor's Award for Agricultural Achievement and the 2019 Southern Cotton Ginners Agricultural Achievement Award.
Bean is an avid fisher and hunter and attends Holcomb United Methodist Church.
He has three children: Colin, Claire and Otto.
